items.title: 구찌 가방 95만원 내렸다…콧대 높던 명품업계에 무슨 일이
items.summary: Reports Gucci cut the Mercato small tote from 4.45 million won to 3.5 million won (-21.3%), the first major Korean luxury price cut in roughly 11 years. Quotes Kering/Gucci parent-level leadership admitting 'excessively raised prices significantly impacted sales volumes' and Prada/Burberry CEOs making similar admissions, framing the move as an industry-wide confession that years of price hikes backfired rather than a simple consumer-friendly gesture. Critical/analytical angle on past pricing strategy.

items.title: Gucci cuts prices, but will Chinese shoppers return?

Independent critical judgment, not activation-derived.
